notes.content:
We received reports that the new version of the game was still crashing for some players, and while we work on fixing this issue, we have decided to bundle the pre-patch version of the game in the installation, so players who are experiencing issues can effortlessly use an older version which may work for them.

When you start Owlboy from Steam, you may now choose the current version by choosing "Play Owlboy", or the original XNA-based version from before the 2022 update, by choosing "Play Owlboy (original version)".

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Owlboy Patch 28th Apr 2022
notes.content:
We've taken the opportunity to update Owlboy on Steam. The game will soon be available to play on Steam Deck.

The latest version should enhance loading-speeds across all operative systems & add additional controller support.

List of changes:
- Changed to FNA, which should fix multiple crashes
- The old XNA version of the game is still available on the "xnaversion" beta branch on Steam
- Level loading is much faster
- More readable Japanese, Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean fonts
- Better error logging, moved logs to C:\Users\<User>\Saved Games\Owlboy\Saves\logs
- One shared build for Windows, Mac, and Linux
- Support for PS4 controller natively
- Help files now available in Data/Help in the install directory
- Many out of bounds and speed-runner glitches fixed

notes.title: Daily Deal - Owlboy 50% Off
notes.content:
Today, for the first time on any platform, we are putting [url=http://www.owlboygame.com/]Owlboy[/url] on a 50% Off for Steam's Daily Deal, celebrating the end of summer - the first summer our team has been able to take a proper vacation post-launch!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/fdfed0397eab592140e179d8d1b67f3a9061113f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Summer & Art[/h1]
And what a summer it's been! While we've been able to relax a little, there's always something going on. The game launched almost 2 years ago, but it still feels like only yesterday.

Fan-art is always a fantastic thing to wake up to. In June, our artist Simon ([url=https://twitter.com/snakepixel]@snakepixel[/url]) prompted a [url=https://twitter.com/snakepixel/status/1013139356264095745]#drawthisinyourstyle[/url] while posting his own artwork of Otus, Owlboy's main character. There's been a ceaseless stream of amazing art popping in since then.

[url=https://twitter.com/snakepixel/status/1013139356264095745][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/f6fb92bc4375412154010e1662c504073e0f45c3.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Thank you to all our incredible fans for showering us in all forms of Otus's this summer![/i]

[h1]Winding Down[/h1]
While Owlboy's been a huge success for us on Steam, it recently hit home consoles, which is what we've mostly concentrated on since the original launch. Recovering has been... trying. In July, [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/the-daunting-aftermath-of-releasing-your-dream-game-as-told-by-the-devs-of-stardew-valley-owlboy-and-more/]PCGamer[/url] did an interview focusing on the aftermath of releasing one's dream game -

[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/the-daunting-aftermath-of-releasing-your-dream-game-as-told-by-the-devs-of-stardew-valley-owlboy-and-more/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/969fd3e902988b3bf6ba0fe91fd460747315207a.png[/img][/url]
[i]I recommend giving it a read, especially since it covers some of my favorite dev's input on a very familiar topic.[/i]

[h1]Summer's End[/h1]
So what does the future bring for our tiny team? We'll let you know soon. Now that we've got some rest, things are slowly ramping up to new and exciting things!

To keep an eye on us or get in touch, always feel free to hook us up at [url=https://twitter.com/DPadStudio]@DPadStudio[/url]. We've also created a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/dpad]Steam Developer Page[/url] if you want to have a peek at our other titles.

[i]We hope you've had a brilliant summer!
All the best ~ Jo, D-Pad[/i]

notes.title: Minor hotfix - version 1.3.6612.16848
notes.content:
This is a minor bugfixing release. The main change in this build is that we've removed a feature that makes Owlboy change to mouse and keyboard-mode if you press a keyboard key, and change to controller-mode if you press a button on your gamepad.

The reason we are disabling this feature is that Steam has released the Steam Controller Configurator, and this would occasionally cause gamepads to be treated as if they were a mouse and keyboard, which would cause Owlboy to switch between gamepad mode and mouse and keyboard mode, and make the game unplayable without some additional complicated configuration.

We hope that this patch will make the game perfectly playable for people who were getting this issue.

Other issues fixed:
- A rare crash that could happen if you gathered a lot of lava monkeys.
- A crash that could be caused by missing Windows permissions, which was forcing some users to play in administrator mode.

notes.title: Beta & Alpha Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Beta Update: Norwegian[/h1]
We are currently playtesting the final language to be added to Owlboy (our own language as it were). If you want to help us test the version before it launches on Saturday, please be our guest - it’s currently available on Owlboy’s Beta Branch here on Steam.

To enter the Beta, right-click Owlboy in your Steam Library, choose the ‘Betas’ pane and select ‘publicbeta’ from the dropdown menu. If you have any feedback, let us know in this thread:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/115800/discussions/1/1489992080500069840/]Owlboy Localization Issues[/url]

[h1]Alpha Update:[/h1]
	Now that our work has concluded on localizing Owlboy (a list of supported languages can be found on the Store Page), we have some other progress to share. These are features that won’t necessarily make it into the final game, but that we would like to make available for those who could need it.

[b]*Warning - Possible Spoilers Ahead*[/b]

[h1]Auto-Aim:[/h1]
While working on Owlboy, I worked up a bad case of Carpal Tunnel, and using the mouse to play the game became excessivly harder. As an experiment, I added a mouse-free way to play the game. It’s an Auto-Aim system that let’s you play the entire game using the following keys:
[list]
[*][b][u]Move Otus/Navigate Menues:[/u][/b] Arrow-keys
[*][b][u]Interact/Throw/Cancel:[/u][/b] Z-key
[*][b][u]Shoot/Teleport/Confirm:[/u][/b] X-key
[*][b][u]Spin:[/u][/b] C-key
[*][b][u]Switch Gunners:[/u][/b] Q or E-keys
[*][b][u]Teleport:[/u][/b] Right-Ctrl or R-key
[/list]

Unless you are already carrying a Gunner when you press X to shoot, the currently selected Gunner will be instantly teleport into Otus’ hands.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/54434503948ce745fe77743a280c6b0e861a1c60.gif[/img]

The auto-aim mode has been added to our new Alpha Branch. This mode will make it easier to play the game using your laptop, or while sitting on a couch. It should be activated by default, but you can enable/disable it by changing the following values in the ‘options’ file, residing in your ‘Saved Games’ folder (C:/Username/Saved Games/Owlboy/Config/).

The values to change are:
[list][*]AutoAim=True
[*]AutoAimMouse=True[/list]

Put them to True or False to enable/disable Auto-Aim mode. The mode works with controllers as well, and makes it so you no longer need to use the Right Thumbstick/Analog Stick to aim. You can still aim using these methods, but once you start using arrowkeys, you gunner will automaticly lock on to the closest target.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/2411295292c1e5da86b812abd2a276a7fdefa960.gif[/img]

This is the main feature introduced in the Alpha, but there are other experiments available as well.

[h1]Difficulty Settings:[/h1]
When starting you game, you can now choose which Difficulty to play the game at. Setting this to Easy will make enemies easier to defeat, while they also hurt Otus less on impact. These settings have not been localized.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/51b668eae6396a71adf5c3ebc04ecbd9085c6d87.gif[/img]

Normal is the same as the final game, and Hard increases enemies health and damage. You can choose the Difficulty Setting when starting a new game, or you can edit your savefile, (C:/Username/Saved Games/Owlboy/Saves/).

Setting difficulty to 0 will activate easy mode, 1 is normal mode, while 2 is hard mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/69ba05951ce77c91190987083bb480107a7ee343.png[/img]

[h1]Dodging:[/h1]
The dodging system has gotten a minor overhaul. In Owlboy, Otus will perfom a dodge roll if you press Space. You can keep spamming Space to perform faster dodges, but after playtesting with this for quite some time, I found it very taxing on my fingers. In the Alpha, you can hold the dodge button to perform a dash, which will blast Otus in the direction he is facing. If you keep holding the dodge button while flying around, Otus will fly faster.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/5c4975382a9314770de03c62728b6902a96b63eb.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/e8606cf040788e24522aff140de6d375c87aee0b.gif[/img]

Dodging will now also teleport Gunners away, which can be of great help when trying to make escapes or avoid getting stuck while entering smaller areas/holes. This setting can be enabled/disabled by adjusting ‘TeleportOutGunnerOnDodge’ in the ‘options’ file.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/5a888a3e0a5623a68e09fdbed4142b2c6b1bf16f.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/1b386c13832e7bd49615a6aedc3dbaf67e296fa3.gif[/img]

While very few enemies can be defeated by Otus’ spin attack, the attack can often be used to stun/disarm an enemy, or remove their shields. In the final game, you could also perform a dodge into certain enemies to disarm them, just like the spin attack. The Dodge Spin will affect more enemies in the Alpha.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/61afde74be66bc79336032304ed69a6e4547aab4.gif[/img]

[h1]Other Minor Tweaks:[/h1]
The Alpha contains other minor tweaks based on the feedback we’ve been recieving from the Steam Community or while showing the game at conventions. These changes include layout improvements and balances to the overall game, like introducing ‘secret walls’, or shortening wait times for a handful of cutscenes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/24e07d324beafa9f8bb324e70f083569a0114e80.gif[/img]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
These are changes that we’ve introduced because of your excellent and continuous feedback! They are very much experimental, and there's a high chance they won't make it into the final game. Despite this, I've found them pretty useful, so I want them to be available for players to test. I’m starting a thread on the Steam Community dedicated to the Alpha build, or feedback on the game in general!

If you have a go at it, please feel free to let us know what you think:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/115800/discussions/1/1489992080500082357/]Alpha Feedback Thread[/url]

All the best ~ Jo, D-Pad

To enter the Beta, right-click Owlboy in your Steam Library, choose the ‘Betas’ pane and select ‘publicbeta’ from the dropdown menu. If you have any feedback, let us know in this thread:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/115800/discussions/1/1489992080500069840/]Owlboy Localization Issues[/url]

[h1]Alpha Update:[/h1]
	Now that our work has concluded on localizing Owlboy (a list of supported languages can be found on the Store Page), we have some other progress to share. These are features that won’t necessarily make it into the final game, but that we would like to make available for those who could need it.

[b]*Warning - Possible Spoilers Ahead*[/b]

[h1]Auto-Aim:[/h1]
While working on Owlboy, I worked up a bad case of Carpal Tunnel, and using the mouse to play the game became excessivly harder. As an experiment, I added a mouse-free way to play the game. It’s an Auto-Aim system that let’s you play the entire game using the following keys:
[list]
[*][b][u]Move Otus/Navigate Menues:[/u][/b] Arrow-keys
[*][b][u]Interact/Throw/Cancel:[/u][/b] Z-key
[*][b][u]Shoot/Teleport/Confirm:[/u][/b] X-key
[*][b][u]Spin:[/u][/b] C-key
[*][b][u]Switch Gunners:[/u][/b] Q or E-keys
[*][b][u]Teleport:[/u][/b] Right-Ctrl or R-key
[/list]

Unless you are already carrying a Gunner when you press X to shoot, the currently selected Gunner will be instantly teleport into Otus’ hands.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/54434503948ce745fe77743a280c6b0e861a1c60.gif[/img]

The auto-aim mode has been added to our new Alpha Branch. This mode will make it easier to play the game using your laptop, or while sitting on a couch. It should be activated by default, but you can enable/disable it by changing the following values in the ‘options’ file, residing in your ‘Saved Games’ folder (C:/Username/Saved Games/Owlboy/Config/).

The values to change are:
[list][*]AutoAim=True
[*]AutoAimMouse=True[/list]

Put them to True or False to enable/disable Auto-Aim mode. The mode works with controllers as well, and makes it so you no longer need to use the Right Thumbstick/Analog Stick to aim. You can still aim using these methods, but once you start using arrowkeys, you gunner will automaticly lock on to the closest target.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/2411295292c1e5da86b812abd2a276a7fdefa960.gif[/img]

This is the main feature introduced in the Alpha, but there are other experiments available as well.

[h1]Difficulty Settings:[/h1]
When starting you game, you can now choose which Difficulty to play the game at. Setting this to Easy will make enemies easier to defeat, while they also hurt Otus less on impact. These settings have not been localized.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/51b668eae6396a71adf5c3ebc04ecbd9085c6d87.gif[/img]

Normal is the same as the final game, and Hard increases enemies health and damage. You can choose the Difficulty Setting when starting a new game, or you can edit your savefile, (C:/Username/Saved Games/Owlboy/Saves/).

Setting difficulty to 0 will activate easy mode, 1 is normal mode, while 2 is hard mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/69ba05951ce77c91190987083bb480107a7ee343.png[/img]

[h1]Dodging:[/h1]
The dodging system has gotten a minor overhaul. In Owlboy, Otus will perfom a dodge roll if you press Space. You can keep spamming Space to perform faster dodges, but after playtesting with this for quite some time, I found it very taxing on my fingers. In the Alpha, you can hold the dodge button to perform a dash, which will blast Otus in the direction he is facing. If you keep holding the dodge button while flying around, Otus will fly faster.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/5c4975382a9314770de03c62728b6902a96b63eb.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/e8606cf040788e24522aff140de6d375c87aee0b.gif[/img]

Dodging will now also teleport Gunners away, which can be of great help when trying to make escapes or avoid getting stuck while entering smaller areas/holes. This setting can be enabled/disabled by adjusting ‘TeleportOutGunnerOnDodge’ in the ‘options’ file.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/5a888a3e0a5623a68e09fdbed4142b2c6b1bf16f.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/1b386c13832e7bd49615a6aedc3dbaf67e296fa3.gif[/img]

While very few enemies can be defeated by Otus’ spin attack, the attack can often be used to stun/disarm an enemy, or remove their shields. In the final game, you could also perform a dodge into certain enemies to disarm them, just like the spin attack. The Dodge Spin will affect more enemies in the Alpha.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/61afde74be66bc79336032304ed69a6e4547aab4.gif[/img]

[h1]Other Minor Tweaks:[/h1]
The Alpha contains other minor tweaks based on the feedback we’ve been recieving from the Steam Community or while showing the game at conventions. These changes include layout improvements and balances to the overall game, like introducing ‘secret walls’, or shortening wait times for a handful of cutscenes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/24e07d324beafa9f8bb324e70f083569a0114e80.gif[/img]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
These are changes that we’ve introduced because of your excellent and continuous feedback! They are very much experimental, and there's a high chance they won't make it into the final game. Despite this, I've found them pretty useful, so I want them to be available for players to test. I’m starting a thread on the Steam Community dedicated to the Alpha build, or feedback on the game in general!

If you have a go at it, please feel free to let us know what you think:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/115800/discussions/1/1489992080500082357/]Alpha Feedback Thread[/url]

All the best ~ Jo, D-Pad

notes.title: Minor bugfixing update - 1.2.6380.40070
notes.content:
This version fixes various bugs that have been found in the previous version, including a few issues that were found in the new localization tools (thanks to StiGMaT on the Steam forums for reporting a number of issues!). Most of these issues affected only a small number of players.

Here is a changelog:

- Fixed a checkpoint that could save out of bounds in the cannon area.
- A crash in the cannon area that would happen on some PCs. This has not been tested widely and feedback is appreciated. If Owlboy crashed when entering the cannon area in the old version and still does, please let us know.
- Bitmap fonts weren't user-editable. They now have a user-editable schema and graphics. If you want to use these and are having trouble (or want more features), send us an email at support@dpadstudio.com
- User-made bitmap fonts would sometimes draw incorrectly if they were too wide.
- Another bug where you could get out of bounds in the Boguin cannon area.
- INI files would sometimes crash if hand-edited.
- Fixed a softlock in the Advent level.
- The game would crash if it couldn't detect any resolutions because of a driver bug.
- After changing languages, the "Continue" menu item would say "Start new game"
- Various mostly cosmetic map fixes.

notes.title: Boguin Cannon Race Update! - v1.1.6233.23511
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/96c3a51e8e7412a6c9b34b29b78040ec195f57d8.png[/img]

[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
The Boguin cannon mini-game now has a new objective! For anyone who wants more of a challenge when they've collected all the rings, you can now compete with other players to get the best times. Compete with either your friends or try to get a spot on the global leaderboard!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/7eb61337202c8b4dd8ff7ca84a94ce7130986e56.png[/img]

The leaderboards can be found in the Boguin Cannon area. 

There are 3 boards.
[list][*]Global Best - displays very top times, located on the left side of the cannon.
[*]Your Rank - displays your rank on the leaderboard,  located on the right of side the cannon.
[*]Friends Rank - shows your rank compared to your Steam friends,  located on the wall above the cannon.[/list]

notes.title: Now Testing - The Boguin Cannon Update
notes.content:
Hello Buds!

This week we’ve been working on something special! You might’ve noticed that we changed how the ‘Boguin Cannon’ works in the last update. This was the first step towards adding the newest addition to Owlboy! We hope you're ready!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/b1bceb39605adab32144d323495bf8a63457fa30.png[/img]

[h1]Boguin Cannon Leaderboards (Now live on Public Beta)[/h1]
It’s time to soar anew! For those daring, we have now added leaderboards to the Cannon area! With every successful flight, your best time will be recorded! Compete with friends or foes!

This is still in beta, and we’re testing out the map layout, fixes, and Steam’s leaderboard functionalities. The beta is subject to major changes, and might not work as intended! We’ll keep this post updated to reflect any changes we make, and please let us know if you encounter any bugs, or have any suggestions. Both love or hate is welcome!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/96c3a51e8e7412a6c9b34b29b78040ec195f57d8.png[/img]


As part of this update, we've added some features. Back in the day, I was a huge fan of the Tony Hawk series, and being able to quickly restart while I was missing tricks was a must-have feature!


We’ve taken measures to make sure that you can quickly get back to soaring if you're off-course.
[list]
[*]Double tap Q or E to quickly restart the course while soaring (LB/RB on controller).
[*]Click left mouse button to skip crash sequence (A button on controller).
[*]Click left mouse to skip the cannon’s launch animatons for a faster start (A button on controller).
[*]Camera should no longer jitter after colliding.
[*]Hide HUD while soaring, to avoid cluttering the screen.
[*]Blocked off a short-cut to keep the course competetive.
[/list]


Following are some features that we still want to adress:
[list]
[*]Re-work camera for better control.
[*]Friends/Weekly/Daily leaderboards.
[*]Turn leaderboards on/off in the menus for those who do not wish to record their scores.
[*]Balance the cannon area’s layout.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/97b49cd697261979ca26b62848418ebbeeecfb5d.png[/img]


To start competing, you can opt into our public beta right away!

To opt into the beta branch, Right Click Owlboy in your Steam Library, select Properties, select the Betas pane, and click ‘publicbeta’ from the drop-down list, and wait for the game to update in your Steam Library.

WARNING: All scores on the leaderboards might be wiped once the update is out of beta, and we are likely to work on major map or feature changes during testing.


See you on the leaderboards!!!

All the best ~ Jo, D-Pad

notes.title: Version 0.0.6184.23706 - Save system update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, and thank to all the players who have been reporting bugs in the Steam forum, where we can get to them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4471313/a42465245cc185be2ed21109a7370f1f4e9bef7a.png[/img]

(If you experience problems with the new version, the previous release is available in Steam through Properties -> Betas, where you can select "previous_release" from the drop-down menu. Here, you can also find our current public beta, where we will test new fixes and features.)

This is a bug fixing update that's been in development since release. For most players, you won't see much of a difference. However, it features a number of improvements:

- A save backup system. The game will now save at key points, so you can go back to any moment in the story. This will overwrite your current save, but is useful in the case that you missed something or your save has become unusable, which has happened in some rare cases. To use the new system, go to the pause menu, go to the System tab, and press "Load from earlier checkpoint".

- Aspect ratio and scaling changes. The game should now be much sharper in fullscreen at 16:9 aspect ratios, it now has pillarboxing, and letterboxing has been improved in other aspect ratios.

- The boguin cannon has been adjusted to make it more fair. Rings can now be gathered in batches, rather than all at once, making it easier to progress. For those who have already mastered the cannon, we have a surprise in store for you in an upcoming patch.

- Level loading now happens on the main thread, resulting in faster load times and better stability.

- Fixed some places in the game where players could get stuck.

- Improvements to memory usage, and miscellaneous bug fixes.

Hope you enjoy the new update, and please continue to report any bugs you may encounter!
-D-Pad Studio

notes.title: Version 0.0.6158.30868
notes.content:
This new patch fixes a few problems that players have been experiencing.

- The Ancient Memories and Treasure Seeker Grand Master achievements were not working correctly. Now they do, and you do not have to create a new save to unlock the achievements if you've already collected all the necessary coins to get them.
- The game would slowly leak memory, especially if players opened the pause menu. Most players were unaffected, but some would crash after long play sessions, and a small subset of players would crash frequently. Now Owlboy's memory usage should never increase over the course of a play session, and base memory usage should be lower.
- We fixed some issues that caused players to get stuck in the Floating Continent Lava area.

More information about other issues is in the Known Issues thread on Steam.
